dedupe_keys.name: satref hong kong satellite positioning reference station network gnss data lands department

description: SatRef, the Hong Kong Satellite Positioning Reference Station Network of the Lands Department, has supported high-accuracy positioning for the public since 2010. Raw data from its 18 continuously operating reference stations, plus the Kau Yi Chau station run by the Marine Department, is published as open data in RINEX format at 1, 5 and 30 second intervals, updated every hour on DATA.GOV.HK with an API, and the stations also stream real-time GNSS data from GPS, GLONASS and BeiDou through NTRIP. The Geodetic Survey states accuracy at millimetre level with long, good-quality observations and precise orbits, or centimetre level with 10 to 15 minutes of observation, and lists uses in control and land boundary survey, geodynamics, slope monitoring, atmospheric water vapour estimation and positioning infrastructure. Access is free under the DATA.GOV.HK terms and conditions; no open licence is named on the dataset page. Caveats: the resource list on DATA.GOV.HK loads by script, and the real-time streams need NTRIP settings. Coverage is Hong Kong. It supports positioning infrastructure studies, slope monitoring and space weather effects on GNSS; the Hong Kong Observatory reports that during the scintillation event of 20 March 2025 the SatRef integrity monitoring page at Quarry Bay showed deviations of more than 100 millimetres. Related records are CROPOS of Croatia and PositioNZ of New Zealand.
